```{r}
library(cvms)
library(groupdata2)
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)

library(jtools)
library(sjPlot) # table functions
library(sjmisc) # sample data
```

```{r}
setwd("~/Google Drive/Volumes/Research Project/Social Evaluative Feedback Pilot/Data Analysis/Testing/")
fullTDdf <- read.csv("fullTDdf.csv")
setwd("~/Google Drive/Volumes/Research Project/Social Evaluative Feedback Pilot/Data Analysis/Testing/")
tbtNeigh <- read.csv("tbtNeigh.csv")
```


```{r}
attach(fullTDdf)
fullTDdf$ZvalEstF <- scale(valEstF)
fullTDdf$ZselfRespT1 <- scale(fullTDdf$selfRespT1)
fullTDdf$ZselfRespT2 <- scale(fullTDdf$selfRespT2)
fullTDdf$ZoutDegree <- scale(fullTDdf$outDegree)
fullTDdf$ZinDegree <- scale(fullTDdf$inDegree)
fullTDdf$ZpredError <- scale(fullTDdf$predError)
fullTDdf$subID <- as.factor(fullTDdf$subID)
```

# Prepare models for cross-validation

```{r}
models <- c("ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + (1 | subID)", 
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZpredError + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZvalEstF + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZpredError + ZvalEstF + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZpredError + ZvalEstF + ZoutDegree + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZpredError + ZvalEstF + ZinDegree + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZpredError + ZvalEstF + ZoutDegree + ZinDegree + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZinDegree + ZpredError*ZoutDegree + ZvalEstF + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZoutDegree + ZpredError*ZinDegree + ZvalEstF + (1 | subID)", 
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZoutDegree + ZpredError + ZvalEstF*ZinDegree + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZinDegree + ZpredError + ZvalEstF*ZoutDegree + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZpredError*ZoutDegree + ZvalEstF*ZinDegree + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZpredError*ZoutDegree + ZvalEstF*ZinDegree + (ZvalEstF | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZpredError*ZoutDegree + ZvalEstF*ZinDegree + (ZpredError | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZpredError*ZoutDegree + ZvalEstF*ZinDegree + (ZpredError + ZvalEstF | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT2 ~ ZselfRespT1 + ZpredError*ZoutDegree + ZvalEstF*ZinDegree + (ZpredError + ZvalEstF | subID) + (1 | Trait)")
```

# Create folds

```{r}
data <- fold(fullTDdf, k = 10,
            num_col = 'ZselfRespT2',
            id_col = 'subID',
            num_fold_cols = 40,
            handle_existing_fold_cols = "keep")
```

# Cross-validate


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, paged.print=FALSE}
gm <- gaussian_metrics(all = TRUE)

CV <- cross_validate(data, models = models,
                     fold_cols = paste0(".folds_", 1:40),
                     family = 'gaussian',
                     REML = FALSE,
                     metrics = gm,
                     control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",
                                 optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)) )
```

# Create dataframe of targets, predictions, and folds for each formula

```{r}
CVdf <- data.frame()
for(i in 1:length(models)){
  CVdf <- rbind(CVdf, data.frame(num = rep(i, length(CV$Predictions[[i]])), formula = rep(models[i], length(CV$Predictions[[i]])), Target = CV$Predictions[[i]]$Target, Prediction = CV$Predictions[[i]]$Prediction, Fold = CV$Predictions[[i]]$Fold ))
}
```

# Cross-validation root mean square error across each model

```{r}
RMSEdf <- data.frame()
for(i in 1:length(models)){
  RMSEdf <- rbind(RMSEdf, data.frame(modelNum=rep(i, length(CV$Results[[i]]$RMSE)), RMSE = CV$Results[[i]]$RMSE) ) 
}
RMSEdf$modelNum <- as.factor(RMSEdf$modelNum)
RMSEdf$minGroup <- 0
meanPerModel <- data.frame(modelNum=1:length(models), mean=tapply(RMSEdf$RMSE, RMSEdf$modelNum, mean) )
RMSEdf <- merge(RMSEdf, meanPerModel, by="modelNum")
minMean <- RMSEdf$modelNum[which.min(RMSEdf$mean)]
RMSEdf$minGroup[RMSEdf$modelNum==minMean] <- 1
RMSEdf$minGroup <- as.factor(RMSEdf$minGroup)

RMSE_re <- ggplot(RMSEdf, aes(x=modelNum, y=RMSE, fill=minGroup)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + theme(axis.text=element_text(size=9),
        axis.title=element_text(size=9,face="bold")) + theme(legend.text = element_text(size=9)) + theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size =1)) + theme(legend.title = element_blank()) + theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  xlab("Model") + ylab("RMSE") + theme(legend.position = "none")

RMSE_re

jpeg("CV_RMSE_reEvalbox.jpg", units="in", width=6, height=4, res=300)
RMSE_re
dev.off()
```

```{r}
MAEdf <- data.frame()
for(i in 1:length(models)){
  MAEdf <- rbind(MAEdf, data.frame(modelNum=rep(i, length(CV$Results[[i]]$MAE)), MAE = CV$Results[[i]]$MAE) ) 
}
MAEdf$modelNum <- as.factor(MAEdf$modelNum)
MAEdf$minGroup <- 0
meanPerModel <- data.frame(modelNum=1:length(models), mean=tapply(MAEdf$MAE, MAEdf$modelNum, mean) )
MAEdf <- merge(MAEdf, meanPerModel, by="modelNum")

MAE_re <- ggplot(MAEdf, aes(x=modelNum, y=MAE, fill=minGroup)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + theme(axis.text=element_text(size=9),
        axis.title=element_text(size=9,face="bold")) + theme(legend.text = element_text(size=9)) + theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size =1)) + theme(legend.title = element_blank()) + theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  xlab("Model") + ylab("MAE") + theme(legend.position = "none")

MAE_re

MAE_re
dev.off()
```


```{r}

panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +

dev.off()
```

# Predictions compared to targets

```{r}
CVdf$target <- scale(CVdf$Target)
CVdf$prediction <- scale(CVdf$Prediction)
for(i in 1:length(models)){
  modelDf <- subset(CVdf, num == i)
  curModel <- lm(target~ prediction , data = modelDf)
  curModel <- assign(paste0("m",i), curModel )
}
```

# Trial-by-trial DF

```{r}
attach(tbtNeigh)
tbtNeigh$ZvalEst <- scale(valEst)
tbtNeigh$ZvalEst <- scale(valEst)
tbtNeigh$ZselfRespT1 <- scale(tbtNeigh$selfRespT1)
tbtNeigh$ZT1averageAllPE <- scale(tbtNeigh$T1averageAllPE)
tbtNeigh$subID <- as.factor(tbtNeigh$subID)
```

# Prepare models for cross-validation

```{r}
models2 <- c("ZselfRespT1 ~ 1 + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT1 ~ ZvalEst + (1 | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT1 ~ ZvalEst + (ZvalEst | subID)",
            "ZselfRespT1 ~ ZvalEst + (ZvalEst | subID) + (1 | Trait)",
            "ZselfRespT1 ~ ZvalEst + ZT1averageAllPE + (ZvalEst | subID) + (1 | Trait)",
            "ZselfRespT1 ~ ZvalEst + ZT1averageAllPE + (ZvalEst + ZT1averageAllPE | subID) + (1 | Trait)"
            )
```

# Create folds

```{r}
data2 <- fold(tbtNeigh, k = 10,
            num_col = 'ZselfRespT1',
            id_col = 'subID',
            num_fold_cols = 40,
            handle_existing_fold_cols = "keep")
```

# Cross-validate


```{r}
gm <- gaussian_metrics(all = TRUE)

CV2 <- cross_validate(data2, models = models2,
                     fold_cols = paste0(".folds_", 1:40),
                     family = 'gaussian',
                     REML = FALSE,
                     metrics = gm,
                     control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",
                                 optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)) )
```

```{r}
data2 %>% head(10) %>% as.data.frame()
```

# Create dataframe of targets, predictions, and folds for each formula

```{r}
CVdf2 <- data.frame()
for(i in 1:length(models2)){
  CVdf2 <- rbind(CVdf2, data.frame(num = rep(i, length(CV2$Predictions[[i]])), formula = rep(models2[i], length(CV2$Predictions[[i]])), Target = CV2$Predictions[[i]]$Target, Prediction = CV2$Predictions[[i]]$Prediction, Fold = CV2$Predictions[[i]]$Fold ))
}
```
